capabilities: Convert Zim wiki pages into linked Markdown notes in a new folder
Preview a planned import with output paths, conflicts and issue counts
Map Zim page links, including child, root and relative lookups, to output paths
Write an import report listing unresolved links and unsupported syntax
Save import rules and compare a later source snapshot (Pro)
disambiguation: Not an importer of .zim offline web archives; it converts Zim Desktop Wiki .txt page files.
extras: Freemium: core conversion is free; Pro (saved rules, source comparison) requires a GitHub Sponsors payment and sign-in. The What's new tab promotes other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat. The author lists untested areas (mobile, Windows/Linux, large notebooks) and warns that imported text may contain remote links Obsidian will fetch.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to migrate a Zim Desktop Wiki notebook, so pages, links and checkbox states would need manual conversion.

relations.evidence: Converts basic Zim Desktop Wiki pages into linked Markdown notes.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once) for Pro

summary: Imports Zim Desktop Wiki notebook folders as linked Markdown notes, with a reviewable plan, conflict checks and an issue report.
